items.name: Fight Club
items.text: Technique-first boxing. Pads, bags and footwork, no sparring until you want it.

items.name: Iron Strength
items.text: Squat, press, pull. Small groups, a coach on every rack and a program that progresses.

items.name: Engine
items.text: Ropes, sleds and rowers in short, hard intervals. Leave nothing in the tank.

items.name: Reset
items.text: Mobility and breathwork that undo a week at a desk and keep you training for years.
